criteria.text: Calculates the last date to serve non-renewal notice as 25 April 2026 (90 days before the 24 July 2026 expiry), and warns that otherwise the agreement renews for 2 years.
Calculates the service credit as $6,500 (10% of the $65,000 monthly fee for 98.6% availability) and identifies that the supplier's offer of $3,250 is too low.

Identifies that data protection breaches are not carved out of the $500,000 liability cap in Clause 11, leaving the customer under-protected for data breach losses, and recommends a separate higher cap or carve-out.
Shows the service credit arithmetic (10% x $65,000 = $6,500) and flags the discrepancy with $3,250.
Gives the notice window as 90 days and as the date 25 April 2026, with days remaining from 16 January 2026 (99 days).
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
